coordinate_note: Approximate country centroids derived from ISO-3166 alpha-2 codes; not entity-precise. DXCC marker is the sole identifier. To avoid dispute, country/region names and ISO codes are NOT stored in this dataset; only the DXCC marker, its prefixes, and an approximate centroid coordinate are kept.
continent_note: Continent approximated from lat/lon centroid (coarse heuristic); intended only for the trainer's 'same continent' weighting tier.
